args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of about 18%. The release candidate v2.3.1-rc had also been unhealthy in staging. checkout-api was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, the service reports healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with an error rate of about 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2), which paged on-call.

- **Starting point:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an error rate of about 18%. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. Since it had already run healthily there, no change-manager approval was needed.
- **Result:** All three regions are now on v2.3.0 and report healthy, with an error rate of about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the next step: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying. The first attempt to create it got a 503 error, so I retried with the same idempotency key. The incident list shows only one incident, so there's no duplicate.
